openai.name: OpenAI
openai.notes: Blossom mark. openai.com/brand returns 403 to scripted downloads, so the lobe-icons mirror was used.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.notes: Anthropic 'A' symbol. The site's own safari-pinned-tab.svg is a 7KB potrace bitmap trace, so the clean lobe-icons vector was used instead.

claude.name: Claude
claude.notes: Terracotta spark (#D97757) served by claude.ai as its favicon.

mistral.name: Mistral AI
mistral.notes: From the official logo zip, file Mistral_Logos_2026/Icon/Gradient/RGB/SVG/Mistral-Icon-Gradient-RGB.svg. The brand page links cms.globalaegis.net, which returned 403; the same file was fetched through mistral.ai/cms-media.

cohere.name: Cohere
cohere.notes: From the press kit zip linked on cohere.com/news, file Cohere Logos/Symbol/Digital (RGB)/Color/cohere_symbol_colour_rgb.svg.

groq.name: Groq
groq.notes: The current site icon is a white bolt on an orange tile, the same as groq.com/apple-touch-icon.png. Groq publishes no standalone symbol SVG, because the brand-guidelines downloads are 404.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.notes: Blue whale (#4D6BFE). deepseek.com only serves a raster favicon, so the lobe-icons colour mirror was used.

xai.name: xAI
xai.notes: xAI symbol. x.ai returns 403 to scripted downloads, so the lobe-icons mirror was used.

perplexity.name: Perplexity
perplexity.notes: Teal colour variant from lobe-icons. Perplexity's own favicon and app icon are a monochrome potrace trace on a black tile, and there is no public press kit.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.notes: Llama head. ollama.com serves only PNG icons, so the lobe-icons mirror was used.
